profile.summary: Spectrum Center Schools and Programs is a special education provider that partners with local school districts. It serves children and young adults with autism spectrum disorders, developmental delays, emotional disturbance and behavioral challenges. It is a division of ChanceLight Behavioral Health, Therapy & Education.
